overview: Docket (1940): telegrams report the Envoy aircraft's disappearance and crash near Taihoku, killing all aboard, no Americans.

people.name: Warner
people.role: Sender or reporting U.S. official at Taihoku

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning the disappearance and crash of the ENVOY
subfiles.about: An administrative file list describes two March 1940 telegrams from Warner concerning the disappearance and fatal crash of the Japan Air Transport Company passenger plane ENVOY.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: telegrams report the Envoy's disappearance between Giran and Taihoku, then its crash killing everyone aboard, no Americans.

interest: Index on the Envoy aircraft's disappearance and crash.
